title: Children Eating at Small Table in Backyard, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot from the 1950s depicting two young children sitting at a small wooden play table in a leafy backyard. One toddler sits in a small chair wearing a dress, while another blonde child sits on a bench eating. The setting features lush garden plants, capturing a quiet moment of mid-century suburban childhood.
